column_description: VARCHAR(50). Foreign key to the returns table (CaseNum). PK, FK to returns.
BIGINT. Satisfaction score for the case resolution. Possible values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
CustomerCommunicationStatus_enum. Current state of communication with the customer. Possible values: In Progress, Initial, Resolved.
REAL. Response time for handling the case. Example: 14.8.
ResolutionSatisfaction_enum. Satisfaction level of the customer after case resolution. Possible values: Dissatisfied, Neutral, Satisfied.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if feedback was provided by the customer. Possible values: No, Yes.
FeedbackCategory_enum. Type of feedback provided by the customer. **NULL means no feedback type provided.**. Possible values: Process, Product, Service.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if the vendor was notified about the case. Possible values: No, Yes.
SupplierCorrectiveAction_enum. Action taken by the vendor regarding the case. **NULL means no vendor action reported.**. Possible values: Completed, Initiated.
ReturnPreventionOpportunity_enum. Opportunity for preventing future returns. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if an action was identified for the case. Possible values: No, Yes.
PreventiveActionStatus_enum. Status of the preventive action. Possible values: Completed, In Progress, Planned.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if the knowledge base was updated after the case. Possible values: No, Yes.
TEXT. Identifies if training was required after the case. Possible values: 0, 1, F, False, N, NO, P, True, Y, YES.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if process improvements are needed. Possible values: No, Yes.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if documentation updates are needed. Possible values: No, Yes.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if system updates are needed. Possible values: No, Yes.
ReportGenerationStatus_enum. State of the report generation for the case. Possible values: Generated, Pending, Reviewed.
DataAnalysisStatus_enum. State of the data analysis for the case. Possible values: Completed, In Progress, Not Started.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if trend analysis was performed for the case. Possible values: No, Yes.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if cost analysis was performed for the case. Possible values: No, Yes.
RecommendationStatus_enum. State of the recommendation for the case. **NULL means no recommendation state provided.**. Possible values: Approved, Draft.
BIGINT. Number of actions taken for the case. Example: 0.
YesNo_enum. Indicates if follow-up is needed for the case. Possible values: No, Yes.
TEXT. Date for the next review of the case. Example: 2025-04-28.
CaseClosureStatus_enum. Current closure state of the case. Possible values: Closed, Open, Pending.
TEXT. Date when the case was closed. Example: 2025-02-19.
TEXT. Notes related to the closure of the case. Example: Above suggest statement likely sound..
